2609.11334.title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
2609.11334.paper_summary: Natural Language Inference processes pairs of sentences to extract their semantic relations. NLI has been a hot research topic, integrated as a main component in other NLP applications. Despite significant advancements in textual inference across various languages all around the world, Arabic language still suffers from limited resources in this domain. To address this gap, this paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs, (2) human-validated machine-translated pairs, (3) hand-crafted pairs from teaching Arabic as foreign language books, and (4) headlines pairs from different news channels containing rumors. E-CONAN contains two benchmark datasets, E-CONAN-2, a 2-way dataset (RTE) and E-CONAN-3, a 3-way dataset (NLI). Additionally, we have used E-CONAN benchmarks to evaluate 9 state-of-the-art multilingual pretrained models using zero-shot classification. Models were evaluated across the ArNLI, XNLI, and E-CONAN datasets. Results show that E-CONAN is a potentially valuable resource for evaluating model generalization and even for fine-tuning pre-trained models. Its diverse composition, derived from a combination of sources, offers a broader and more robust assessment compared to XNLI and ArNLI. In addition, we have evaluated 5 LLMs on E-CONAN-3 dataset. Moreover, we incorporated MARBERT as a representative Arabic-specific baseline and conducted performance evaluation comparison to demonstrate how Arabic-specific models scale against cross-lingual and LLM-based approaches on the E-CONAN benchmarks. Furthermore, we conducted detailed qualitative and quantitative error analysis to analyze frequent error patterns. E-CONAN benchmarks will be publicly available, we hope that it will enrich research community in Arabic textual entailment and natural language inference.
2609.11334.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言推斷處理句子對以提取其語義關係。NLI已成為一個熱門研究主題，並作為其他NLP應用的主要組成部分。儘管在全球各種語言的文本推斷方面取得了顯著進展，但阿拉伯語在這一領域仍然面臨資源有限的問題。為了解決這一差距，本文介紹了E-CONAN基準，該基準由來自各種來源的句子對組成：(1) 自動翻譯的句子對，(2) 經過人工驗證的機器翻譯句子對，(3) 來自教學阿拉伯語作為外語書籍的手工製作句子對，以及 (4) 來自不同新聞頻道的包含謠言的標題句子對。E-CONAN包含兩個基準數據集，E-CONAN-2，一個2路數據集（RTE）和E-CONAN-3，一個3路數據集（NLI）。此外，我們使用E-CONAN基準對9個最先進的多語言預訓練模型進行了零樣本分類評估。模型在ArNLI、XNLI和E-CONAN數據集上進行了評估。結果顯示，E-CONAN是一個潛在的有價值資源，用於評估模型的泛化能力，甚至用於微調預訓練模型。其多樣的組成，源自多種來源的組合，提供了比XNLI和ArNLI更廣泛和更強健的評估。此外，我們在E-CONAN-3數據集上評估了5個LLMs。此外，我們將MARBERT作為代表性的阿拉伯語特定基準，並進行了性能評估比較，以展示阿拉伯語特定模型在E-CONAN基準上與跨語言和基於LLM的方法的規模對比。此外，我們進行了詳細的定性和定量錯誤分析，以分析常見的錯誤模式。E-CONAN基準將公開可用，我們希望它能豐富阿拉伯語文本推斷和自然語言推斷的研究社區。
